method: Per phase, four calls in this order: B1 (fetch), B2 (fetch; same log plus one human answer), B1 again (fetch), B1 through Strands json_schema. Phase cache_prompt_off first, then cache_prompt_on on the same server; with two or more slots, then two_slots_concurrent (cache off): B1 alone, then B1 and B2 at the same time. Two answers are the same when their text sha256 and output token count match.

prompt_sharing.note: Across different scenarios only the shared prefix (system prompt and template header) could be reused; this is the most cache_prompt true could save per call.
